description: Real-webcam test set (Phase 6). Keypoints only: no images, video, audio or names. One JSON file per recording session, saved locally by the participant's browser.

notes.frame_size: size of the image MediaPipe processed (always 480 rows, ADR 007)
notes.camera_size: size the camera delivered, logged only
notes.t_ms: milliseconds from the clip's first frame, strictly increasing
notes.left/right: the signer's own hands (unmirrored frames; the preview is mirrored for display only)
notes.participant: adult_confirmed must be true (18+ only). fluent_isl_signer separates fluent signers from non-native imitators in every report.
notes.reference_clips: include50_train_local = INCLUDE train clips were shown from the local cache (dev server only); none = no reference shown.
notes.consent: version 1 is the first version used with participants (no session was recorded with earlier drafts).
